sort.title: Drag to sort, or press the up and down arrow keys
sort.space: Sort {name}: space {position} of {total}. The up and down arrow keys move it.
sort.favorite: Sort {name}: favorite {position} of {total}. The up and down arrow keys move it.
sort.favorite_alone: The only favorite of its profile: there is nothing to sort
sort.profile: Sort {name}: profile {position} of {total}. The up and down arrow keys move it.
sort.profile_alone: The only profile: there is nothing to sort

name_icon.title: Name and icon
name_icon.name: Name
name_icon.icon_hint: Shows on the space's button in the sidebar.
name_icon.own_icon_hint: A picture such as a PNG or an SVG, in place of the icons above. It syncs with the space, so it is kept small.

profile.title: Profile
profile.hint: A profile is a set of logins of its own: cookies, site data and extensions. Spaces in one profile are signed in to the same accounts.
profile.private: A private profile: what its pages store is gone when Magnetite quits.
profile.shared: Shared with {spaces}. Changing it loads this space's pages again, signed in as the other profile is.
profile.change: Changing it loads this space's pages again, signed in as the other profile is.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.hint: Adding this space's pinned tabs to them, deleting, importing and exporting are in Bookmarks.

device.title: On this device
device.only_hint: Not synced: the space stays here, and devices that still sync it lose it with their next sync.
device.keys_none: No keys go straight to this space.
device.links_none: No site's links are sent to this space.

delete.label: Delete this space
delete.last: The last space cannot be deleted.
delete.hint: Its pinned and Today tabs move to the archive.

page.current: This is the space the window shows now.

list.title: All spaces
list.hint: A space is a sidebar of its own for one part of your day, with its own tabs. Their order here is their order in the sidebar: drag a space by its handle to sort. A private space forgets its logins, cookies and site data when Magnetite quits.

new.label: A new space
new.hint: It comes last in the sidebar. Its profile decides which logins its pages use.
new.name: Name

private.label: Private
private.on_title: Private: its logins, cookies and site data are gone when Magnetite quits. Turning it off loads its pages again in the profile it had before, or the main one.
private.off_title: Make this space private: its pages load again in a profile of its own that is forgotten when Magnetite quits.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.hint: A profile is a set of logins of its own: cookies, site data and extensions. What uses the same profile is signed in to the same accounts; a second profile is how to use a second account of one site. A private profile is not listed: it is forgotten when Magnetite quits. The order here is the order of every list of profiles, and of the favorites in the sidebar.
profiles.delete_title: Its logins, cookies and site data leave this computer the next time Magnetite starts

new.label: A new profile
new.hint: It starts empty: nothing is signed in. Give it to a space when adding the space or on its page, or to a favorite in Favorites.
new.name: Name

for_favorites.title: Profiles for favorites only
for_favorites.hint: A profile needs no space. A favorite runs in its own profile whichever space is in front: its page stays signed in to that profile's accounts, and its cookies and site data stay apart from the space's. The history is one list for all profiles; only a private profile leaves nothing in it.
for_favorites.label: Give a favorite a profile
for_favorites.label_hint: In Favorites, each favorite has a list to choose its profile from.

page.name: Name
page.name_main_hint: The profile Magnetite starts with keeps its name.
page.colour_hint: Its favorites in the sidebar are tinted with it, and so is its name beside a space.
page.colour_main_hint: Its favorites in the sidebar are tinted with it, and so is its name beside a space. Without one they are plain.
page.delete_used: Only a profile that nothing uses can be deleted.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.hint: The sites at the top of the sidebar, each with its address. A favorite shows in every space, or only in the spaces you choose, and runs in a profile: its own page has both. A copy in another profile (right-click → Duplicate favorite) is a second account of the same site. As in the sidebar, every profile has a list of its own, and a favorite is sorted inside its list.
favorites.remove_title: Its page moves to the archive.

new.label: A new favorite
new.hint: By its address. It comes last in the list of its profile and shows in every space. Its profile decides which logins its page uses.

page.name: Name
page.name_hint: Without a name of its own it goes by its site's.
page.shows_hint: Every space, or only the spaces chosen here.
page.profile_hint: Its page uses the logins of this profile, whichever space is in front.
page.address_hint: Where the favorite goes, and where it returns to. Its page loads a new address at once.
